g.text: The 2012 jump in the hotspot record is the instrument, not the fire activity

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Northeast Brazil, 2003–2025. VIIRS records about 6.3 times as many detections as MODIS Aqua over the same years (2012–2025).

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Source: NASA FIRMS active fire detections (MODIS Aqua and Terra; VIIRS S-NPP 375 m), presumed vegetation fires, nominal and high confidence, pilot bounding box.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Estimates: model fb-l1-terra-rec-4, calibrated on 2012–2019; uncertainty intervals not shown yet. January 2012 is estimated. 2022 and 2024 include months with S-NPP outages.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A detection is not a fire and not burned area. Chart code written with AI assistance.
